_comment: Cards that exist only for the static `step_is` condition test (tests/unit/statics/test_static_step_condition.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_end_step_flash` is Final-Word Phantom's third line alone, on a vanilla artifact, so the condition is what is tested and not the body. `t_end_step_bruiser` is a layered self-buff switched by the same leaf, the witness that the characteristics cache is re-read as the step moves.

cards.name: Test End Step Permission
cards.oracle_text: During each opponent's end step, you may cast spells as though they had flash.

abilities.text: During each opponent's end step, you may cast spells as though they had flash.
